content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not weigh a live chain-against-chain collision; it rules the press moot because the challenged curse limb was dropped.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"pressed against a link — reading one: a dropped limb is not a live link, so K-C does not apply; reading two: the original press still triggers K-C despite the drop.","why":"The judge dismissed C4 because the defender dropped the targeted limb, not because no single pressed verse states the contrary, so the stating-verse test K-C retires was not used."}
